review_text: Another typical CCD experience which will be there when you visit one in a shopping mall. review_text: Ordered through swiggy. Fraction of the menu is available for delivery. Just 3 types of hot coffee and 3 cold coffee and 3 others. review_text: Went for a coffee date there. Ordered a cold Americano, cold Latte and Paneer Burger. My date didn't like her Americano much.
